summary_1line: In heaven Yudhishthira sees Duryodhana honored, insists on finding his kin, endures a vision of hell for them, then learns it was a divine test before reunion.

image_candidates.scene_text: Yudhishthira walks through a horrific path of darkness, corpses, and boiling rivers while unseen voices of his suffering brothers call out to him.
The gods arrive and the terrifying hellscape suddenly dissolves into light and fragrant wind around the steadfast Yudhishthira.
In heaven Yudhishthira beholds his kin in celestial forms—Karna shining like many suns, Bhima among the Maruts, and Draupadi radiant with lotus garlands.
